title: Acme Foods opens warehouse in Sanand
text:
Acme Foods Limited has inaugurated a new warehouse in Sanand, Gujarat, with 2 lakh sq ft of space.
The facility will serve modern trade customers across western India, the company said in a statement.

title: Sanand gets new Acme Foods warehouse
text:
Acme Foods Limited has inaugurated a new warehouse in Sanand, Gujarat to serve western India.
Officials attended the opening ceremony on the outskirts of Ahmedabad city.

title: Acme Foods India plans Surat plant
text:
Acme Foods India Private Limited announced a new manufacturing plant in Surat, Gujarat.
The unit will make packaged snacks for export markets.

title: Zenith Polymers plant in Vapi

title: Orbit Pharma capacity push
text:
Orbit Pharma announced a new manufacturing facility to boost capacity.
The company did not disclose where the plant would come up.

title: Nova Steel to set up Hazira plant
text:
Nova Steel will invest Rs 500 crore in a new plant at Hazira, Gujarat.
Construction is expected to start next quarter.

title: Nova Steel Hazira investment
text:
Nova Steel will invest Rs 700 crore in a new plant at Hazira, Gujarat.
The plant will produce coated steel for appliance makers.
